label: step-001
payload: Initialize a git repository here — run each git command separately, no '&&' chains. Write a file called 'inventory.py' with a module docstring and these documented functions: 'add_item(items, name, qty)' appends an item dict and returns the list; 'total_qty(items)' returns the sum of each item's "qty". Then stage 'inventory.py' and commit with the message "baseline".
